controller_contract.persisted_domain: canonical explicit CNF with max width <= 4
controller_contract.R33_nonterminal_authority: authorized only if successor max width <=4
controller_contract.R33_nonterminal_escape: preserve escaped exact result/history as evidence, reject as successor, continue from unchanged state
controller_contract.next_lane_after_R33_rejection: R49H direct exact DP, then exhaustive R47J over every current variable
controller_contract.R49H_authority: recompute token; exact DP; independent replay; no fresh variables; strict variable descent; persisted W4
controller_contract.R47J_authority: terminal OR no-fresh strict-variable-descent final W4 successor; independent replay required
controller_contract.OPEN: all current variables checked and no authorized R33/R49H/R47J successor exists

reachable_lane.deadcore_if: reachable SAT state returns guarded OPEN after exact all-pivot replay

falsifiers.guarded_U: Any reachable SAT W4 state for which guarded controller returns OPEN and independent exact replay confirms every current pivot lacks an authorized R49H/R47J successor.
falsifiers.stronger_all_W4: Any SAT W4 state, reachability not established, with blocked/identity R33 lane and no R49H/R47J successor.
integrity: guarded OPEN disagrees with independent all-pivot audit
SAT witness does not directly verify

interpretation.reachable_deadcore_found: refutes guarded U for the frozen guarded machine
interpretation.all_W4_deadcore_only: refutes stronger all-W4 coverage only; reachable-U remains open
interpretation.no_deadcore_found: finite negative search result only; does not prove U
interpretation.all_workers_green: infrastructure success only; theorem depends on symbolic proof, not finite corpus
